children: America's Car-Mart entered into an extension under its First Amendment and Limited Waiver to its Credit and Guaranty Agreement, providing continued waivers of certain defaults and temporary relief from minimum liquidity and collateral coverage covenants. Agreed with Silver Point Finance, as Administrative Agent, and the lenders, the extension moves the waiver and relief period to October 22, 2026. The company is pursuing strategic alternatives and believes discussions with third parties and lenders remain active.
: First Amendment and Limited Waiver to Credit and Guaranty Agreement (covenant relief extension)
: Silver Point Finance, as Administrative Agent, and the lenders
: Preserve liquidity while evaluating strategic alternatives
